flagships.name: iTeach
flagships.description: A flagship initiative where volunteers visit government schools to support students through teaching, mentorship and engaging learning activities.

flagships.name: Give For Good
flagships.description: A cancer awareness and fundraising initiative by the Rotaract Club of BMSCE that promotes early detection and supports cancer patients facing financial challenges.

flagships.name: Khushiyon Ka Dabba
flagships.description: A flagship community outreach program dedicated to spreading joy and providing essential supplies to underserved communities during festive seasons.

flagships.name: Kali Kannada
flagships.description: An interactive language-learning initiative that helps non-Kannada speakers learn basic Kannada through engaging activities while fostering cultural appreciation and inclusivity.

flagships.name: Ankuram
flagships.description: A 3-day initiative where Rotaract volunteers visit government schools and teach students through co-curricular activities.

events.title: Onam Utsavam
events.shortDescription: A vibrant cultural celebration marking the beginning of the Rotaract year. Featuring traditional arts, music, and interactive games, Onam Utsavam brings the community together to share joy and cultural pride.

events.title: Potluck Party
events.shortDescription: A club bonding initiative by the Rotaract Club of BMSCE that brings committee members together over shared meals and conversations to strengthen friendships, teamwork, and unity.

events.title: Turf Fusion
events.shortDescription: A team-bonding initiative by the Rotaract Club of BMSCE that brings members together through cricket, fostering teamwork, sportsmanship, and stronger connections beyond club responsibilities.

events.title: Cue N Connect
events.shortDescription: A recreational club initiative by the Rotaract Club of BMSCE that brings members together through snooker, encouraging relaxation, friendly competition, and stronger bonds.

events.title: Children's Day
events.shortDescription: A day filled with fun, frolic, and games for the children of the community.

events.title: Placement Decode
events.shortDescription: Decoding the professional realm! A dynamic session that delved into resume building, interview strategies, and the nuances of corporate etiquette, equipping participants with essential skills for their future careers.

events.title: Kadlekayi Parishe
events.shortDescription: An environmental initiative promoting plastic-free practices through eco-friendly paper bags, vendor awareness, and a festival-wide plogathon.

events.title: Santa Bow-Wow
events.shortDescription: A festive celebration promoting animal welfare through fun activities, responsible pet ownership, and a puppy adoption drive.

events.title: Collars of Care
events.shortDescription: A community-driven initiative using reflective collars to improve street dogs' visibility at night and reduce road-accident risks.

events.title: Paw-Lentine's Day
events.shortDescription: A valentine's celebration for dogs promoting love, responsible pet ownership, and adoption, with three puppies finding forever homes.

events.title: Kits Of Care
events.shortDescription: A heartwarming initiative dedicated to providing essential care packages to those in need. Through Kits of Care, we distribute hygiene products, food supplies, and other daily necessities, ensuring that vulnerable communities receive the support they deserve.

events.title: Humans of Rotaract
events.shortDescription: An interactive video series by the Rotaract Club of BMSCE that highlights Rotaractors’ experiences, memorable moments, and perspectives on leadership, fellowship, and service through engaging conversations.

events.title: Dhanyawada Gurus
events.shortDescription: Virtual fellowship session exploring cultural traditions and youth action with Rotaract Munich.

events.title: Sangeet Mein Zaroor Aana
events.shortDescription: A musical evening filled with captivating performances, melodious tunes, and foot-tapping rhythms. This event brings together music lovers to enjoy a spectacular showcase of talent, creating an unforgettable experience for all attendees.

events.title: Change The Narrative : Suicide Prevention
events.shortDescription: A mental health awareness initiative by the Rotaract Club of BMSCE that promotes suicide prevention, challenges stigma, and encourages empathy, open conversations, and peer support.

events.title: Rotas Dayout
events.shortDescription: A recreational outing by the Rotaract Club of BMSCE that brings members together through adventure activities, indoor games, and shared experiences, fostering stronger friendships, teamwork, and club unity.

events.title: AI Crossroads
events.shortDescription: An international collaborative initiative by the Rotaract Club of BMSCE and the Rotaract Club of Biratnagar Central, Nepal, exploring the benefits and ethical challenges of artificial intelligence through interactive discussions and expert insights.
